title: Koala Ke Fingerprints Insanon Jaise Hain! 🐨 #shorts
idea: Koala fingerprints are so similar to human fingerprints that they have occasionally been confused at crime scenes.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai koala ke fingerprints insano se match karte hain?
Science kehti hai inki lines itni similar hain ki forensic experts bhi dhokha kha jaate hain.
Yahan tak ki crime scenes par police inhein insani nishan samajh kar confuse ho chuki hai.
Jabki yeh pyare se animals din mein 20 ghante sirf sote hain.
Inka dimaag bhi baaki mammals ke mukable 60% chota hota hai.
Kya aapko lagta hai inka yeh secret koi nayi saazish hai?
